climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A West Virginia AVA of 640,000 acres in the Kanawha River watershed, near Charleston. It lies wholly within the state and is a sub-appellation of the Ohio River Valley AVA. Its first winery, Fisher Ridge, began in 1979.
